<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('tetris');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
const COLS = 10;
const ROWS = 20;
const BLOCK_SIZE = 30;
ctx.scale(BLOCK_SIZE, BLOCK_SIZE);

const COLORS = [
  null,
  '#FF0D72', // I
  '#0DC2FF', // J
  '#0DFF72', // L
  '#F538FF', // O
  '#FF8E0D', // S
  '#FFE138', // T
  '#3877FF'  // Z
];

function createMatrix(w, h) {
  const matrix = [];
  while (h--) matrix.push(new Array(w).fill(0));
  return matrix;
}

const TETROMINOES = {
  I: [[1,1,1,1]],
  J: [[2,0,0],[2,2,2]],
  L: [[0,0,3],[3,3,3]],
  O: [[4,4],[4,4]],
  S: [[0,5,5],[5,5,0]],
  T: [[0,6,0],[6,6,6]],
  Z: [[7,7,0],[0,7,7]]
};

function rotate(matrix, dir) {
  const h = matrix.length;
  const w = matrix[0].length;
  let result;
  if (dir > 0) {
    result = Array.from({length: w}, () => new Array(h).fill(0));
    for (let y = 0; y < w; ++y) {
      for (let x = 0; x < h; ++x) {
        result[y][x] = matrix[h - 1 - x][y];
      }
    }
  } else {
    result = Array.from({length: w}, () => new Array(h).fill(0));
    for (let y = 0; y < w; ++y) {
      for (let x = 0; x < h; ++x) {
        result[y][x] = matrix[x][w - 1 - y];
      }
    }
  }
  return result;
}

const player = {
  pos: {x:0, y:0},
  matrix: null,
  score: 0
};

function playerDrop() {
  player.pos.y += 1;
  if (collide(arena, player)) {
    player.pos.y -= 1;
    merge(arena, player);
    playerReset();
    arenaSweep();
    updateScore();
  }
  dropCounter = 0;
}

function playerMove(dir) {
  player.pos.x += dir;
  if (collide(arena, player)) player.pos.x -= dir;
}

function playerReset() {
  const pieces = 'IJLOSTZ';
  const rand = pieces[Math.floor(Math.random()*pieces.length)];
  player.matrix = TETROMINOES[rand];
  player.pos.y = 0;
  player.pos.x = Math.floor(arena[0].length / 2) - Math.floor(player.matrix[0].length / 2);
  if (collide(arena, player)) {
    arena.forEach(row => row.fill(0));
    player.score = 0;
    updateScore();
  }
  updateScore(); // show matrix in score
}

function playerRotate(dir) {
  const pos = player.pos.x;
  let offset = 1;
  const m = rotate(player.matrix, dir);
  player.matrix = m;
  while (collide(arena, player)) {
    player.pos.x += offset;
    offset = -(offset + (offset > 0 ? 1 : -1));
    if (offset > player.matrix[0].length) {
      rotate(player.matrix, -dir);
      player.pos.x = pos;
      return;
    }
  }
}

function collide(arena, player) {
  const [m, o] = [player.matrix, player.pos];
  for (let y=0; y<m.length; ++y) {
    for (let x=0; x<m[y].length; ++x) {
      if (m[y][x] !== 0 && (arena[y + o.y] && arena[y + o.y][x + o.x] !== 0)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function merge(arena, player) {
  const [m, o] = [player.matrix, player.pos];
  for (let y=0; y<m.length; ++y) {
    for (let x=0; x<m[y].length; ++x) {
      if (m[y][x] !== 0) {
        arena[y + o.y][x + o.x] = m[y][x];
      }
    }
  }
}

function arenaSweep() {
  let rowCount = 1;
  outer: for (let y = arena.length - 1; y > 0; --y) {
    for (let x = 0; x < arena[y].length; ++x) {
      if (arena[y][x] === 0) {
        continue outer;
      }
    }
    const row = arena.splice(y, 1)[0].fill(0);
    arena.unshift(row);
    ++y;

    player.score += 10 * rowCount;
    rowCount *= 2;
  }
}

function drawMatrix(matrix, offset) {
  matrix.forEach((row, y) => {
    row.forEach((value, x) => {
      if (value !== 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[value];
        ctx.fillRect(x + offset.x, y + offset.y, 1, 1);
      }
    });
  });
}

function draw() {
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  drawMatrix(arena, {x:0, y:0});

  ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.05;
  for (let i = 0; i <= COLS; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(i, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(i, ROWS);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  for (let j = 0; j <= ROWS; j++) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, j);
    ctx.lineTo(COLS, j);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  drawMatrix(player.matrix, player.pos);
}
